sources.note: Developer devnoname120 shares real-hardware gameplay footage of Call of Duty: World at War Zombies running on PS Vita.

findings: World at War Zombies native Vita execution demonstrated on real hardware by veteran homebrew architect devnoname120. Shows Nacht der Untoten loading and gameplay rendering. No standalone public VPK or open-source repository published yet.
vita_hardware_result: Direct capture on real Vita hardware showing playable zombies round.
